candidates.title: EasyBalance: Cross-Layer Load Balancing in Distributed MoE Inference
candidates.reason: expert-device mappingを変えずcross-layer workloadを共同scheduleしてMoE imbalanceを相殺し、追加overheadほぼなしでGPU idlingを多くの設定で40%以上削減。

candidates.title: AFD-Ledger: Deployment Provisioning for Attention--FFN Disaggregation
candidates.reason: MoEのAttention-FFN disaggregationとcollocated配置を同一budget/SLO下で分析的にprovisionし、deployment評価を68.8–83.5%削減しつつglobal optimumを回収。

candidates.title: From Expert Reduction to Behavioral Divergence: Tracing Numerical State through Sparse MoE Inference
candidates.reason: sparse-MoE runtimeでexpert reduction順序・accumulator precisionがrouting/stateへ伝播する数値互換性問題を制御実験で特定し、runtime/hardware backendのcompatibility contractを示す。

candidates.title: Dynamo-MoE: Accelerating Sparse Large Model Inference with Dynamic Parallelization
candidates.reason: token sorting・on-demand expert loadingとworkload-aware TP/EP切替をpipeline overlapで統合するMoE推論framework。vLLM比TTFT最大6.75倍削減、TPOT 1.59倍、throughput 1.5倍改善。
